About the AWP | Electric Hive

High risk and high reward, the infamous AWP is recognizable by its signature report and one-shot, one-kill policy. It has been spray-painted using mesh fencing and cardboard cutouts as stencils. A predator is a predator, no matter the environment The AWP | Electric Hive is a Classified-grade skin in Counter-Strike 2, featuring the Electric Hive finish on the AWP. With a Classified rarity classification, it has approximately a ~0.64% chance of dropping from case openings.

How to Obtain: The AWP | Electric Hive can be unboxed from the eSports 2013 Winter Case. It belongs to the eSports 2013 Winter Collection.

Float Value and Wear: This skin has a float value range of 0.00 to 0.40. This restricted float range means not all wear conditions are available, which can affect rarity and pricing for specific exteriors. Lower float values within each condition tier produce a cleaner in-game appearance and typically command higher prices.

Price and Market Trends: The AWP | Electric Hive (Factory New) has a median market price of approximately $178.43, with the lowest listing prices available in the marketplace comparison below. The price has remained stable with minimal movement over the past 7 and 30 days, indicating balanced supply and demand. Across wear conditions, prices range from $39.84 (Field-Tested) to $178.43 (Factory New).

Community Rating: The AWP | Electric Hive has a community rating of 3.6 out of 5 based on 887 votes. This above-average rating suggests the community considers it a solid choice among AWP skins.

Frequently Asked Questions

What's the difference between Factory New and Minimal Wear for the AWP | Electric Hive?

Factory New (FN) AWP | Electric Hive skins have float values between 0.00-0.07, showing minimal to no visible wear. Minimal Wear (MW) floats range from 0.07-0.15, with slight scratches or fading. This skin has a restricted float range (0.00-0.40), meaning Battle-Scarred versions don't exist. The price gap between FN and MW varies by finish — some designs like the Electric Hive pattern hide wear better than others, making MW versions a strong value alternative.

Is the AWP | Electric Hive worth the price?

The AWP | Electric Hive sits in the mid-to-high price bracket. It features a distinctive Electric Hive design that stands out in-game and maintains good trading liquidity. It's part of the The eSports 2013 Winter Collection, obtainable from the eSports 2013 Winter Case, which adds to its collectible appeal. For players who main the AWP, this skin offers an excellent balance of visual appeal and investment stability compared to budget alternatives.

What is the float value range for the AWP | Electric Hive?

Float values in CS2 determine a skin's wear level on a scale from 0.00 (perfect) to 1.00 (maximum wear). With a float range of 0.00 to 0.40, this skin has specific wear availability that affects pricing. Lower float values within any condition category (e.g., 0.01 vs 0.06 in Factory New) result in cleaner appearances and typically command higher prices. For high-value trades, always verify the exact float value using inspection tools.

Where is the cheapest place to buy the AWP | Electric Hive?

Prices for the AWP | Electric Hive vary across marketplaces due to fees, regional pricing, and seller competition. This skin can be obtained by opening the eSports 2013 Winter Case or purchased directly from third-party marketplaces. The Steam Community Market charges 15% fees, while third-party markets like Skinport, DMarket, and Buff163 offer lower prices with 2-10% fees. Compare real-time prices in the market comparison table above to find the best deal.

Can I use the AWP | Electric Hive in competitive CS2?

Yes, all weapon skins including the AWP | Electric Hive are purely cosmetic and can be used in all CS2 game modes including competitive matchmaking, Premier, and professional tournaments. Skins provide no gameplay advantages or disadvantages - they only change the weapon's visual appearance. Many professional players use skins during official matches, and you'll often see high-value items like this featured in tournament broadcasts.

Is the AWP | Electric Hive price going up or down?

The AWP | Electric Hive has remained relatively stable in price recently, with less than 5% movement over the past 7 and 30 days. Stable pricing suggests balanced supply and demand. This can be a good sign for investors looking for low-volatility items, and for buyers it means you're unlikely to overpay. Check the price chart above for longer-term trends.

What collection is the AWP | Electric Hive from?

The AWP | Electric Hive is part of the The eSports 2013 Winter Collection. It can be obtained by opening the eSports 2013 Winter Case. All skins from the same collection share a rarity hierarchy, which affects trade-up contract possibilities and overall value.

What is the story behind the AWP | Electric Hive?

The in-game description reads: "High risk and high reward, the infamous AWP is recognizable by its signature report and one-shot, one-kill policy. It has been spray-painted using mesh fencing and cardboard cutouts as stencils. A predator is a predator, no matter the environment" The Electric Hive finish on the AWP is a distinctive design that has made this skin a recognizable part of CS2's visual identity.
